title: Qaafela sheh ka salaami labe darya
body:
Qaafela sheh ka salaami labe darya utra
par muqaddar me na ek paani ka qatra utra
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ka jo kisi shehr me naqsha utra
mujrayi bole zamee'n arshe mo'alla utra
<<DIVIDER>>
imtehaa'n ki jo taraazu me qaza ne tola
Hur wafaadarie shabbir me poora utra
<<DIVIDER>>
fouj manzil pa utar'ti to sakina kehti
saahibo dekho kidhar hai mera baba utra
<<DIVIDER>>
gird beto'n ko phira kar ye kaha zainab ke
mera bhai ki bala rad ho ye sadqa utra
<<DIVIDER>>
sajdae haq se nbi ne na uthaaya sar ko
pushte aqdas se na jab tak ke nawaasa utra
